profile: External European open-AI contributor; Python/software engineering; local CPU development and automated tests; 2-6 hours; no access to HPC, model training clusters, or private data
question: Where can I make one concrete, independently testable contribution to open European AI research software?
exclusion: Previously human-reviewed issues excluded before ranking; no use of their review labels as features
baseline: GitHub REST Search Issues /search/issues, best-match order per query, deterministic round-robin across repository groups/terms, no enriched state/relevance
enrichment: Same raw pool; verify issue/comments, check cross-referenced PRs; extract literal typed links and verify up to two referenced code paths
decision_gate: Do not claim relative quality until method-blinded manual issue review has been completed
sampling_note: This is a fixed stratified GitHub Search API query set, not a single complete global GitHub search or representative European inventory.
